title: Decision: Webshare proxy default vs fallback
description: Given household-IP collateral risk, decide if YTT_PROXY_URL is default (protect home IP) or fallback-only. Blocks Phase 10.

comments.author: cli
comments.text: DECISION (v1): Webshare = FALLBACK-only. Cluster egress is residential natively, so YTT_PROXY_URL stays unset by default and is flipped only if the home IP gets burned (signaled by ytt_egress_is_residential / block-rate). Revisit making it the default if sustained volume grows or household-collateral risk is judged too high (Risks section). Most worth a human re-confirm of the three.

title: Decision: per-subject vs global cache/rate-limit scoping
description: Scope cache keys + rate limits per OAuth subject or global. Affects Phase 4/5.

comments.author: cli
comments.text: DECISION: cache GLOBAL (keyed by video_id+lang), rate-limits PER-SUBJECT. Rationale: a transcript is public content identical regardless of who asked, so a per-subject cache would duplicate it for no benefit; rate limits and Whisper quota stay per-subject for fairness/abuse control. No multi-tenant cache partitioning in v1.

title: Reconcile version metadata + backfill CHANGELOG for 0.2.2-0.2.5

comments.author: cli
comments.text:
## Problem (plan vs artifacts)
Four versions shipped with real code changes since the last CHANGELOG entry, but release metadata is inconsistent and the CHANGELOG was not updated. plan.md Phase 11 makes the CHANGELOG a release-gating deliverable ("CHANGELOG (keep-a-changelog; entries gate each release tag)").

### Evidence
- VERSION file = 0.2.5
- ytt/__init__.py __version__ = 0.2.1
- pyproject.toml version = 0.2.1
- CHANGELOG.md: newest released section is [0.2.1]; [Unreleased] is empty
- git log shows four releases NOT in the changelog:
  - 0.2.2 feat(authz): case-insensitive allowlist + @domain patterns
  - 0.2.3 fix(fetch): bump yt-dlp 2025.5.22 -> 2026.7.4
  - 0.2.4 fix(fetch): allow_unplayable_formats so DRM'd videos still yield captions
  - 0.2.5 fix(fetch): ignore_no_formats_error so caption-only extract survives DRM

Note: the code changes themselves are complete and DO have unit tests (test_fetch.py covers the DRM options; test_auth.py covers the @domain / case-insensitive allowlist). This is purely a metadata + changelog-hygiene gap, not a missing-feature or missing-test gap.

## Acceptance criteria
- ytt/__init__.py __version__, pyproject.toml version, and VERSION all agree (0.2.5).
- CHANGELOG.md has dated entries for 0.2.2 through 0.2.5 under keep-a-changelog headings describing the authz + fetch/yt-dlp changes above.
- [Unreleased] reflects reality (empty or listing anything not yet tagged).

comments.author: cli
comments.text: Progress / phase map (tied to docs/plan/plan.md). Phase chain (each blocks the next, all block this genesis): P0 ytt-5m5 scaffold+CI | P1 ytt-3ld skeleton+canonicalizer | P2 ytt-5c8 fetch core+json3 dedup | P3 ytt-4th concurrency | P4 ytt-2c4 cache | P5 ytt-219 auth/authz | P6 ytt-5rr whisper | P7 ytt-30a response shape | P8 ytt-1ed observability | P9 ytt-5c4 integration tests | P10 ytt-40t deploy (BLOCKED human-gated) | P11 ytt-4iv public release. Gating spikes: json3 dedup ytt-7oe (blocks P2), FastMCP metadata ytt-7dk (blocks P5), whisper model+RT ytt-3te (blocks P6), longhorn class ytt-4rl (blocks P4). Decisions: Webshare default ytt-1rm (blocks P10), image pull source ytt-5m4 (blocks P0), identity scoping ytt-28b (affects P4). ibkr do-no-harm gate ytt-u9o (BLOCKED, blocks P10). Start work: the 7 spikes/decisions are the only unblocked beads.

title: Decision: cluster image pull source - GHCR-only vs dual-push Docker Hub
description: GHCR-only public pull (no secret, diverges from Docker Hub convention) vs dual-push ronaldraygun/ytt. Blocks Phase 0 build config.

comments.author: cli
comments.text: DECISION: GHCR-only public pull. Cluster pulls the public ghcr.io/jedarden/ytt image directly (no imagePullSecret). Rationale: public OSS tool, single registry, no Docker Hub secret to maintain for this app; divergence from the cluster Docker Hub convention is acceptable and cleaner for a public project. Reversible: add dual-push to ronaldraygun/ytt only if a private fallback is later wanted. Update plan Image-publishing accordingly.
